name: Tang
author: Xtreme31
description: At 10%, time a click on the red orb and then don’t click to escape the level as the reverse gravity ship. Stay slightly above the level until 14% where you need to fly back into the level through the black orbs. At 23%, stay below the saw and above the wave portal until 24.5% when you can fall above the level. Maintain a constant position until 32% when you can move more down and then maintain a constant position for the rest of the level.
